heading: MUI License Plan
proposed: The generator's Pro-feature check treats only 'pro' as licensed, so a 'premium' plan can skip Pro-only code paths. Workaround: after generating with muiLicensePlan=premium, check the @mui/x-data-grid imports and DataGridPremium usage; use 'pro' if they differ.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Page-Level Actions
proposed: The create container takes its create button from the first button of the first button group only. Workaround: keep the create operation in the first ActionButtonGroup of the page.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: ActionGroup (ui:ActionGroup)
proposed: A page is treated as having a FAB group when any nested button group in the container is a FAB, even if no top-level group is. Workaround: place FAB groups directly under the page container.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Custom Operations
proposed: For an operation parameter whose type is a relation, the generated page can pick the wrong service class in one branch. Workaround: check the generated page's service import and use a non-relation parameter until fixed.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Values That Break the Generator
proposed: The generator stops with a null error when the first title column of a table has an attribute without a data type. Workaround: give every attribute shown as a table title column a data type.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: ActionGroup (ui:ActionGroup)
proposed: A FAB button group with one button and featuredActions set to 0 is not rendered as a speed dial, so the button may not appear as expected. Workaround: set featuredActions to 1 or add a second button.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Row Actions
proposed: Row-button disabled conditions combine '&&' and '||' with the wrong precedence, so a row button can be enabled when its precondition is not met. Workaround: add an explicit enabledBy condition on the row button and check its state in the generated table.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Row Actions

heading: Relation Element Types
proposed: The autocomplete row count for a table relation is always 10 and ignores the table argument and configured row count. Workaround: accept 10 rows or use a custom autocomplete widget.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Values That Break the Generator
proposed: Listing the same primitive type twice in a mask entry makes the generator fail with IllegalArgumentException. Workaround: list each primitive type once.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Page Definition Properties
proposed: The 'Page title has not been set!' warning never fires because the breadcrumb's initial label is undefined, not null. Workaround: set the page title explicitly on every page.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Layout Visual Elements
proposed: The page header uses alignItems="vertical", which MUI ignores, so header items are not aligned as the model implies. Workaround: override the PageHeader fragment in the custom folder.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: OperationForm Confirmation
proposed: Closing the operation confirmation dialog by backdrop click or Escape never resolves the pending answer as 'no', so the calling flow can hang. Workaround: treat dismissal as cancel in custom code and do not wait on the dialog without a timeout.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: DataFilter (ui:DataFilter)
proposed: Filter dialog labels are wrong for some filter parts: every operator option uses the 'Operation' key, and the boolean checkbox stores the raw checkbox value, so the filter may not switch off when unchecked. Workaround: translate the 'Operation' key and verify boolean filters after unchecking.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.

Workaround: set the redirect URI to the app root in the auth configuration and reload after changing the redirect service.

heading: OpenAPI Client for OSGi (`jaxrs-cxf-client-osgi-ds`)
proposed: With the gzip feature enabled, the generated OSGi service activator references GZIP interceptor classes without importing them, so the bundle may not compile. Workaround: disable useGzipFeature or add the missing imports in a custom template.
note: Judged from the triage claim and fact; not re-checked on latest develop.
